description: Turn any text, URL, payment link, Wi-Fi login or contact card into a QR code. Returns an SVG (inline and as a data URI) plus the module matrix, with error-correction level L/M/Q/H, custom colors and quiet zone. Up to 2,000 bytes of data at levels L and M, 1,663 at Q, 1,273 at H. Costs $0.001 per call.

border.description: Quiet-zone modules around the code (default 4; scanners need at least 2).

ecc.description: Error correction: L 7%, M 15% (default), Q 25% (max 1,663 bytes), H 30% (max 1,273 bytes; use H if you'll overlay a logo).

include_matrix.description: Also return the matrix as rows of 0/1 strings.

name: qr_code
title: QR code generator
